title: primula bella subsp. stragulata
intro: Primula bella subsp. stragulata, commonly known as the Alpine Cowslip or Primrose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Primula bella subsp. stragulata include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a useful remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
